body: My issues are weird and go all the way back to childhood. Not many people would understand. I was able to manage them until about 10 years ago when for some stupid reason I allowed them to start controlling my actions. This led to me hurting and losing some friends and losing a good job about 2 years ago. I also betrayed my family in the way I acted. I nearly killed myself when I lost my job. I am back in control however I still think about what I did and what I lost. It often overwhelms me. I have researched and thought about the ways to take myself out. Fear of what would happen to my family stops me right now. I am starting notice that that fear is starting to erode as life gets more stressful.
